hbs.label: HBS / BCG field experiment - 2023
hbs.scope: 758 BCG consultants; knowledge-work tasks using GPT-4. Benefits refer to tasks inside the tested capability frontier, not audit accuracy.

iia.label: The IIA - AI Auditing Framework - 2024
iia.scope: Professional guidance. The audit canvas and examples in this deck are teaching syntheses, not a reproduction of the official framework.

nist.label: NIST - AI RMF 1.0 - 2023
nist.scope: Voluntary framework: Govern, Map, Measure, Manage. Use the 1.0 edition explicitly; it is under revision.

nist-gen.label: NIST - Generative AI Profile - 2024
nist-gen.scope: Cross-sector guidance on generative AI risks; not proof that a particular product is safe.

erm.label: NC State / AICPA - State of Risk Oversight - 2026
erm.scope: Executive survey: 69% report increased risk volume/complexity over five years; 30% describe oversight as mature/robust. These are different questions, not complementary percentages.

rsm.label: RSM · Middle Market AI Survey · 2026
rsm.scope: U.S./Canada study: 1,030 respondents from organisations already using AI, including pilots. The 86% integration and 36% fully-embedded figures describe this sample; they do not measure adoption across all businesses or in Indonesia.

rsm-method.label: RSM · Survey methodology · 2026
rsm-method.scope: Fieldwork 5–16 March 2026: 827 U.S. and 203 Canadian respondents, management level or above with influence over technology investment. Government and nonprofits excluded. All participating organisations already used AI.

gias.label: The IIA · Global Internal Audit Standards · 2024
gias.scope: 2024 edition, effective January 2025. References include Standards 4.3, 11.5, 13.2, 14.1–14.4 and 15.2. The deck paraphrases selected implications for internal audit; it does not replace the Standards or prescribe financial-statement audit requirements.

iso.label: ISO/IEC 42001 · AI management systems · 2023
iso.scope: Official ISO overview of the AI management system standard. Organisational governance requirements are distinct from proof of a model’s accuracy. No certification or clause-by-clause conformance conclusion is made in this seminar.

coso.label: COSO · ERM: Strategy & Performance · 2017
coso.scope: COSO connects enterprise risk management with strategy setting and performance. The feedback diagram is an RSM seminar explanation of that connection, not a reproduction of COSO’s official framework or an endorsement of a scoring method.

agents.label: Anthropic · Building effective agents · 2024
agents.scope: Engineering guidance distinguishing predefined workflows from model-directed tool use. Used for the architectural distinction, not a benchmark, audit standard or claim that autonomy is always preferable.

pcaob.label: PCAOB staff · GenAI outreach · 2024
pcaob.scope: July 2024 staff observations from limited U.S. audit-firm and preparer outreach, especially pp. 4–5. Historical practice evidence, not a Board rule, a current adoption survey, or Indonesian audit requirements.

rsm-regional.label: RSM · The responsible auditor
rsm-regional.scope: RSM regional practitioner discussion with Indonesian participation: AI governance, accountability, human oversight and audit capability. Thought leadership, not a quantitative study.

secure-ai.label: NCSC · Secure AI development
secure-ai.scope: Secure design, development, deployment and operation guidance. Supports threat modelling, access, monitoring and lifecycle controls; it does not guarantee confidentiality or certify the reference architecture.

data-disclosure.label: OWASP · Sensitive data disclosure · 2025
data-disclosure.scope: LLM02:2025. Data sanitisation, least privilege, source restriction and disclosure risk. A control in a prompt or a redaction step is not a complete privacy guarantee.

prompt-injection.label: OWASP · Prompt injection · 2025
prompt-injection.scope: LLM01:2025. Untrusted content can redirect an LLM application; controls must address the application, tools and permissions rather than relying on a system prompt alone.

agent-security.label: OpenAI · Agent approvals & security
agent-security.scope: Product-specific guidance on agent permissions, sandboxing and command networking. Shell restrictions do not establish offline model inference or cover every hosted search, app or MCP path. Diagrams simplify these distinctions for general audiences; they do not reproduce the exact interface.

work-data.label: OpenAI · ChatGPT Work enterprise overview
work-data.scope: Enterprise/Edu Work documentation: conversations, uploaded files, memory and connected sources can have distinct retention and deletion lifecycles. Not a universal consumer ChatGPT or API policy.

claude-data.label: Anthropic · Claude Code data usage
claude-data.scope: Claude Code documentation distinguishes consumer and commercial data use, model-improvement choices and feedback/session-sharing. Conditions depend on the account and feature; not a statement of every provider’s terms.

claude-permissions.label: Anthropic · Claude Code permissions
claude-permissions.scope: Supported tool permissions, file-read restrictions and scopes. Read-only, working directory and gitignore are not interchangeable privacy boundaries; verify the actual tool configuration.

claude-faq.label: Anthropic · Claude Code user FAQ
claude-faq.scope: Primary product explanation: CLI tools can read local source content and send it to hosted inference. This is specific to cloud-backed Claude Code use, not every local agent or offline model.

nist-trust.label: NIST · Trustworthy AI characteristics
nist-trust.scope: AI RMF 1.0 section 3 and Figure 4. Seven interconnected qualities, with validity/reliability as a foundation and accountability/transparency across the others. Context and trade-offs matter; this is not an audit certification checklist.

api-data.label: OpenAI · API data controls
api-data.scope: API-specific documentation reviewed 13 November 2026: API data is not used for training by default unless opted in. Retention and processing controls are separate. Do not apply this statement to every personal chatbot account or feature.

echoleak.label: Microsoft MSRC — CVE-2025-32711
echoleak.scope: Vendor advisory for a resolved M365 Copilot information-disclosure vulnerability. This case establishes a real AI attack surface, not evidence of a confirmed customer breach.

rsm-ia.label: RSM Indonesia — Internal Audit
rsm-ia.scope: Public RSM Indonesia internal-audit service information. Specific AI penetration-testing and AI-supported assessment capabilities are supplied by the RSM presenters, not independently demonstrated by this brochure.

nvidia-local.label: NVIDIA — Self-hosted RAG Blueprint
nvidia-local.scope: Technical deployment reference for self-hosted, on-premises RAG components. The location diagram is a teaching architecture, not a security certification or a claim that RAG prevents retention or training.

ms-analytics.label: Microsoft Research — Natural-language data analytics
ms-analytics.scope: Research into turning natural-language questions into analysis programs. Supports a changed interaction model, not a claim that LLMs eliminate statistical testing or are accurate on every analytical task.

sklearn-evaluation.label: scikit-learn — Cross-validation and model evaluation
sklearn-evaluation.scope: Documentation on evaluating models with held-out data and cross-validation. Supports the distinction between exploratory LLM assistance and validated predictive modelling.

slides.title: The impact of AI on data analytics workflows
slides.lead: From operating every technical step to giving AI the task.
slides.notes: Bandingkan pekerjaan yang terlihat oleh pengguna. Sebelumnya analis menjalankan perumusan tugas, persiapan data, pemilihan model, pelatihan, pengujian dan penyajian. Pada contoh LLM-first, pengguna menjelaskan analisis yang diinginkan lewat prompt dan agent menangani pembacaan, alat, analisis serta visualisasi. Animasi berulang menunjukkan pekerjaan teknis berpindah ke belakang prompt. Ini ilustrasi alur analisis dokumen dan data sehari-hari, bukan klaim bahwa semua pemodelan prediktif menjadi tugas yang sama atau metode teknis tidak diperlukan. Jelaskan pembedaan itu secara lisan tanpa memenuhi slide dengan detail evaluasi model.
slides.notesEn: Compare the work visible to the user. Previously the analyst operated task definition, data preparation, model selection, training, testing and presentation. In the LLM-first example, the user describes the desired analysis in a prompt and the agent handles reading, tools, analysis and visualisation. The animation repeats the technical work moving behind the prompt. This is a workflow illustration for everyday document and data analysis, not a claim that all predictive modelling becomes the same task or that technical methods cease to exist. Keep that distinction in the spoken explanation rather than crowding the slide with model-evaluation details.

slides.title: Data protection when using AI
slides.lead: A model-improvement opt-out is one safeguard. It does not remove the other checks.
slides.notes:
Safeguard umum: pakai akun/layanan yang disetujui, matikan penggunaan untuk model improvement bila tersedia, verifikasi aturan akun yang berlaku, minimalkan dokumen, batasi folder/konektor/penerima, periksa penyimpanan dan penghapusan, serta review hasil. Pengaturan yang digambar merupakan ilustrasi, bukan screenshot atau jaminan nama menu tertentu. Pada layanan yang menawarkan model-improvement opt-out, penolakan training tidak berarti tidak dikirim online, tidak disimpan, atau tidak dapat diakses processor. Ketentuan consumer, workspace bisnis dan API dapat berbeda. OpenAI API tidak memakai data untuk training secara default kecuali opt-in; jangan menerapkan aturan API itu otomatis ke akun chatbot personal. Tidak perlu mengubah setting akun peserta saat presentasi. Jangan upload dokumen terlarang meskipun training off.

slides.title: On-premises AI for sensitive information
slides.lead: A conservative data-location choice: an entirely on-premises AI workflow.
slides.notes:
Alur on-premise dapat mempertahankan pemrosesan dalam kendali infrastruktur organisasi dengan antarmuka chatbot atau agent yang tetap familiar. Ini pilihan konservatif untuk lokasi data, bukan klaim bahwa setiap sistem on-premise lebih aman daripada setiap layanan cloud. Jalankan retrieval, embedding, inferensi dan layanan pendukung secara lokal; batasi koneksi keluar serta periksa telemetri, log, konektor, backup dan dukungan jarak jauh. Tinjau kapasitas perangkat, kualitas model, pemeliharaan dan hak akses. Pengunduhan model serta pembaruan dapat dikendalikan terpisah dari pemrosesan dokumen produksi. Sesuai informasi pembicara, RSM Indonesia telah membantu beberapa klien di Indonesia menerapkan AI on-premise. Jangan mengungkap identitas klien atau mengarang hasil terukur.

RAG di dalam alur yang sama:
Jelaskan RAG memakai kebijakan kredit internal. Dokumen berizin diproses dan dibuat indeks pencariannya. Saat ada pertanyaan, retriever menemukan potongan relevan yang boleh diakses pengguna, lalu menambahkannya ke masukan model. Repositori asli tidak digantikan bobot model dan RAG tidak memerlukan pelatihan ulang model dasar atas repositori itu. Namun, model TETAP memproses teks yang diambil saat inferensi. RAG sendiri tidak menjamin nihil retensi vendor atau melarang training berdasarkan kebijakan penggunaan data yang berbeda. Layanan inferensi atau embedding cloud masih dapat menerima teks perusahaan. Alur sepenuhnya lokal harus mencakup embedding, retrieval, inferensi dan proses pendukung, dengan filter akses dan log yang aman. Bedakan dari fine-tuning. Jawaban yang memiliki sitasi tetap diverifikasi ke sumber asli.
slides.notesEn:
An on-premises route can keep processing under the organisation’s infrastructure control while retaining a familiar chatbot or agent interface. This is a conservative data-location choice, not a claim that every on-premises system is more secure than every cloud service. Keep retrieval, embeddings, inference and supporting services local; restrict outbound connections and examine telemetry, logs, connectors, backups and remote support. Check hardware capacity, model quality, maintenance and access rights. Model downloads and updates can be controlled separately from production document processing. The RSM presenters confirm that RSM Indonesia has helped several clients in Indonesia implement on-premises AI. Do not identify clients or invent measurable outcomes.

RAG within the same workflow:
Explain RAG using an internal credit policy. First, authorised documents are processed and indexed. At question time, the retriever finds relevant permitted passages, which are added to the model’s input. The original repository is not replaced by model weights and RAG does not require retraining the base model on that repository. However, the model DOES process the retrieved text during inference. RAG alone neither guarantees no provider retention nor prevents training under an unrelated data-use policy. A cloud inference or embedding service can still receive company text. A fully local deployment must include embeddings, retrieval, inference and ancillary processing, with access filtering and secure logs. Distinguish this from fine-tuning. A cited answer still needs verification against the original source.

slides.title: Auditing AI systems
slides.lead: What are we trying to gain confidence in?
slides.notes: Kita beralih dari mengenali alat ke memeriksa proses yang memakai AI. Banyak framework dapat membantu, tetapi tujuan dan lingkupnya berbeda. Gunakan karakteristik trustworthy AI NIST untuk membentuk pertanyaan audit yang mudah dimengerti. Setelah itu gunakan kasus akuntabilitas chatbot dan contoh keputusan kredit Aruna. slides.notesEn: Define the audit objective before choosing a framework. The IIA, NIST and ISO support different questions. Examine the intended use, affected people, controls and available evidence rather than a generic demonstration.

slides.title: AI governance and audit frameworks
slides.lead: Use a recognised reference to define the question and scope—not as a universal checklist.
items: AI assurance and sound internal-audit practice.
slides.notes:

Konformitas penuh membutuhkan akses persyaratan dan bukti yang memadai, bukan checklist ringkas dari seminar. Peta ini hanya membantu menentukan fungsi referensi.

slides.title: NIST characteristics of trustworthy AI
slides.lead: NIST AI RMF 1.0: reliability is foundational; accountability and transparency run across the other qualities.
slides.notes:
Gunakan tujuh karakteristik NIST AI RMF 1.0 bagian 3 dan Figure 4: valid and reliable, safe, secure and resilient, accountable and transparent, explainable and interpretable, privacy-enhanced, fair with harmful bias managed. Kriteria, ambang uji, risiko serta bobotnya perlu sesuai intended use dan pihak terdampak; memeriksa setiap kotak secara terpisah tidak menjamin trustworthiness. NIST RMF sukarela, bukan standar audit wajib.

slides.title: Case study: EchoLeak in Microsoft 365 Copilot
slides.lead: EchoLeak shows why enterprise AI belongs in the audit universe.
slides.notes: EchoLeak, CVE-2025-32711, adalah kerentanan nyata pada M365 Copilot yang diungkap dan ditangani pada 2025. Email eksternal yang dirancang khusus dapat memengaruhi pemrosesan konteks internal dan membuka jalur pengungkapan informasi. Ini kasus kerentanan, bukan klaim kebocoran pelanggan terkonfirmasi. Implikasi audit adalah sintesis materi: inventarisasi AI yang terhubung, periksa kepercayaan sumber, batas izin, tindakan keluar, log dan pengujian adversarial. Persetujuan produk tidak menggantikan pengawasan atas penggunaannya dalam proses bisnis.
slides.notesEn: EchoLeak, CVE-2025-32711, is a real vulnerability in M365 Copilot, disclosed and remediated in 2025. A crafted external email could influence processing of internal context and enable information disclosure. It is a documented security vulnerability, not a claim of a confirmed customer breach. The audit implication is our synthesis: inventory connected AI, inspect source trust, permission boundaries, outbound actions, logs and adversarial testing. An approved product does not remove the need to examine its configured business use.

narrative.question: An approved AI tool. An untested trust boundary.
narrative.transition: EchoLeak shows why enterprise AI belongs in the audit universe.

slides.evidenceNote: Resolved vulnerability; this case does not establish a confirmed customer breach.

slides.title: Security testing of AI-enabled systems
slides.lead: Business assurance and adversarial testing answer complementary questions.
slides.notes: Audit internal memeriksa tujuan, tata kelola, hasil dan efektivitas kontrol. Pentest AI yang berizin menguji ketahanan batas tersebut terhadap masukan adversarial. Sesuai informasi pembicara, RSM Indonesia memiliki kapabilitas pentest sistem AI dengan pengalaman eksploitasi prompt injection yang telah diuji. Jangan menyatakan RSM menemukan EchoLeak, menyebut klien atau mengarang tingkat keberhasilan. Tetapkan ruang lingkup, izin, akun uji, pengelolaan bukti dan pengujian ulang.
slides.notesEn: Internal audit examines purpose, governance, outcomes and control effectiveness. Authorised AI penetration testing probes whether those boundaries hold against adversarial inputs. RSM Indonesia has an AI-system penetration-testing capability with demonstrated prompt-injection exploitation experience, as supplied by the presenters. Do not imply that RSM discovered EchoLeak, name a client, or invent a success rate. Agree scope, permissions, test accounts, evidence handling and retesting before testing.

narrative.question: Test the AI workflow. Not only the infrastructure.
narrative.transition: Business assurance and adversarial testing answer complementary questions.

slides.title: Using AI in audit
slides.lead: Useful help for the task. Human authority over the result.
slides.notes: Kita sudah membahas AI sebagai objek audit. Sekarang posisikan AI sebagai bantuan auditor: menyusun laporan dan slide, serta menganalisis data atau dokumen. Periksa dulu kerahasiaan dan jalur penggunaan yang diizinkan. Meskipun AI dapat mengerjakan tugas, manusia tetap memiliki hak dan kemampuan untuk memeriksa, mengubah, menolak dan menghentikan. Dari sini bergerak ke ide yang melampaui pekerjaan harian.

narrative.question: Audit with AI.
narrative.transition: Useful help for the task. Human authority over the result.

slides.notesEn: Now use AI to help the auditor. Reports, slides and analysis can benefit from assistance, but confidentiality and human authority govern the work. The next question is whether the same capability can support a useful repeatable system.

slides.title: Confidential data in AI-assisted audit work
slides.lead: A no-training switch alone is not permission to share a client document.
slides.notes:
Pola praktik yang disarankan, bukan sebuah standar formal bernama gold standard: kewenangan dan klasifikasi data ditetapkan, tool/account/processor disetujui, ketentuan training/retensi/lokasi/akses sesuai kebutuhan, scope dan informasi diminimalkan, serta output diperiksa. Bila lingkungan belum disetujui untuk raw confidential data, gunakan schema/contoh fiktif untuk meminta metode, rumus atau kode. Orang yang kompeten meninjau dan menguji lalu menjalankannya sendiri pada lingkungan lokal tepercaya, dengan data asli di luar akses agen; hanya ringkasan yang disetujui dibagikan bila diizinkan. Bukan cloud code interpreter atau command agen yang mengirim stdout mentah ke model. Model lokal/offline hanya boleh diklaim jika seluruh alur benar-benar diverifikasi. Redaksi dan agregasi dapat tetap mengungkap informasi. Bila tidak dapat dipenuhi, jangan kirim dokumen tersebut.

Pertanyaan: Confidential work? Use an approved path. Penghubung: A no-training switch alone is not permission to share a client document.

narrative.question: Confidential work? Use an approved path.

slides.title: Human authority and human-in-the-loop controls
slides.lead: Decide what can run automatically, what needs review, and what must stop for approval.
slides.notes:
Human in the loop bukan sekadar tombol setuju di akhir. Definisikan keputusan, materialitas, kompetensi reviewer, hak mengubah/menolak dan kondisi berhenti. AI bisa menyiapkan langkah atau bahkan menyelesaikan banyak task di dalam izin. Scope audit, penerimaan kriteria, kesimpulan, laporan dan respons risiko tetap memerlukan pihak yang berwenang. Review harus memeriksa bukti, bukan hanya bahasa yang rapi. Jangan menempatkan auditor sebagai pemilik keputusan manajemen. Tunjukkan konsep ini lagi saat approve annual plan, programme, report dan risk review.

Pertanyaan: AI can do the task. People keep the authority. Penghubung: Decide what can run automatically, what needs review, and what must stop for approval.

narrative.question: AI can do the task. People keep the authority.
narrative.transition: Decide what can run automatically, what needs review, and what must stop for approval.

slides.notesEn:
AI may prepare a draft or propose an action. A person must be able to inspect sources, challenge assumptions, change the result, reject it or stop. Approval without time, competence or genuine discretion is not meaningful human authority.

slides.lead: The same capability can help build a dashboard, a repeatable programme or a whole application.

AI dapat membantu spesifikasi, kode, pengujian, dokumentasi dan antarmuka, tetapi akses data, kualitas, operasional, keamanan dan maintainability tetap pekerjaan nyata. Jangan mengatakan semua ide otomatis layak produksi atau tidak membutuhkan kompetensi manusia.

slides.title: AI and the idea–execution–usage gap
slides.lead: AI opens up what we can imagine and build. Actual use is a separate test.
slides.notes: Gunakan ilustrasi kerumunan ini untuk membuka paradoks, bukan membacakan diagram proses. Sebelum AI, sedikit orang menginisiasi ide, lebih banyak orang terlibat dalam eksekusi, dan banyak orang memakai hasilnya. Dengan AI, lebih banyak orang dapat menghasilkan ide serta membangun. Pertanyaan yang sengaja dibuat mencolok: siapa yang benar-benar akan memakai hasilnya? Gambar terinspirasi arah visual referensi yang diberikan presenter, tetapi digambar ulang khusus untuk deck dengan identitas RSM. Tekankan: eksekusi aman tetap perlu usaha; ide yang berguna, adopsi, dan hasil nyata tetap harus diuji. Survei RSM pada slide berikut memberi bukti terpisah tentang perbedaan integrasi, bukan bukti jumlah figur di sini.

slides.lead: One idea to test: an AI-supported assurance system, from annual priorities to a reviewed finding.
slides.notes: Satu ide yang akan diuji: AMS untuk PT Aruna Distribusi Nusantara, organisasi contoh yang menjual secara kredit dan perlu menjaga penerimaan kas. Ikuti perencanaan tahunan, fieldwork, dan reporting. Buka aplikasi dari slide perencanaan, kerjakan objek Customer credit & collections, lalu terbitkan temuan sebagai sinyal risiko. Saran berupa contoh tersiap dengan aturan transparan, bukan model live. Human authority berlaku pada rencana, programme, temuan, dan keputusan risiko.

slides.title: AI in annual audit planning
slides.lead: AI connects risk evidence to the audit universe; people approve the portfolio.
slides.notes: Konsep sebelum demo. Mulai dari strategi dan objek audit, lalu agregasikan risiko, perubahan, bukti kontrol dan kesenjangan cakupan. AI dapat mengekstrak dan mengaitkan bukti, mengusulkan prioritas yang dapat ditelusuri serta alternatif portofolio dengan batas kompetensi dan kapasitas. Bobot 40/20/20/20 dan prioritas 86/72/58 adalah asumsi pembelajaran, bukan hasil riset atau formula IIA. Sisihkan sepuluh dari enam puluh hari untuk pekerjaan wajib; tiga puluh ditambah dua puluh hari menggunakan kapasitas sisanya. Jelaskan penundaan audit cabang dan pantau kesenjangan cakupan. Validasi kualitas sumber dan informasi yang belum tersedia sebelum persetujuan; perbarui saat ada perubahan material. Konsep ini lebih luas daripada demo yang sengaja disederhanakan.
slides.notesEn: Concept before the demonstration. Begin with strategy and auditable objects, then aggregate risk, change, control evidence and coverage gaps. AI can extract and relate evidence, propose a traceable priority and suggest alternative portfolios under skill and capacity limits. The displayed 40/20/20/20 weights and 86/72/58 priorities are teaching assumptions, not calculated research or an IIA formula. Reserve ten of sixty days for mandatory work; thirty plus twenty days then fits the remaining capacity. Explain why a branch review is deferred and monitor the residual coverage gap. Validate source quality and missing information before approval; refresh after material changes. This concept is broader than the deliberately simple demonstration.

narrative.question: Plan for coverage. Explain the choices.
narrative.transition: AI connects risk evidence to the audit universe; people approve the portfolio.

slides.title: AI in audit fieldwork
slides.lead: AI connects the work; auditors validate the criteria, evidence and conclusion.
slides.notes: Bawa tujuan dan risiko yang telah disetujui ke penugasan. AI mengusulkan program, sumber kriteria, permintaan bukti dan penugasan auditor. Reviewer memvalidasi versi referensi dan relevansinya sebelum pengujian. Dalam contoh audit kredit ini diperiksa 1.240 pesanan; 18 catatan tidak memiliki lampiran persetujuan. Auditor menelusuri dan menemukan bukti sah untuk enam catatan, sehingga tersisa dua belas pengecualian terkonfirmasi. Flag dari model belum menjadi temuan. Rekam metode, populasi, tautan bukti dan keterbatasan; telusuri akar sebab dan konfirmasi respons manajemen. Laporan dan slide hanya disusun dari fakta yang telah direviu. Ini bukan penugasan klien atau klaim tingkat kejadian. Demo berikut mewakili logika ini dengan lebih sedikit objek dan catatan.
slides.notesEn: Carry the approved objective and risk into the engagement. AI proposes a programme, source criteria, evidence requests and auditor assignments. Reviewers validate reference versions and relevance before testing. In this illustrative credit audit, 1,240 orders are examined; 18 records lack attached approval evidence. The auditor investigates and locates valid evidence for six, leaving twelve confirmed exceptions. The model’s flags are therefore not findings. Record the method, population, evidence links and limitations; investigate root cause and confirm management responses. Generate the report and slides only from reviewed facts. The example is not a client engagement and does not claim a prevalence rate. The following demo represents this logic with fewer objects and records.

narrative.question: From a risk question to defensible evidence.
narrative.transition: AI connects the work; auditors validate the criteria, evidence and conclusion.

Formula adalah contoh transparan, bukan metode scoring resmi IIA atau probability model. Mandatory work masuk dahulu; sisa objek dipilih berurutan menurut priority bila sesuai kapasitas hari audit. Tidak mengklaim optimasi matematis. User meninjau parameter, coverage, risiko yang belum terpilih, kapasitas, alasan dan approver. Perubahan asumsi membatalkan approval plan; project yang sudah dibuat tetap terjaga.

slides.title: RSM Indonesia: audit transformation and AI-supported assessment
slides.lead: RSM Indonesia supports internal audit transformation and AI-supported assessment.
slides.notes: RSM Indonesia menyediakan business process reengineering audit internal: memperjelas keputusan, peran, bukti dan gerbang reviu sebelum digitalisasi. Pembicara juga menyampaikan bahwa sistem asesmen COBIT berbantuan AI sudah dikembangkan. Jelaskan pemetaan kriteria, pengorganisasian bukti, usulan simpulan dan reviu yang bertanggung jawab. Ini dapat diperluas ke ISO dan kepatuhan regulasi rutin dengan menyesuaikan kriteria, lisensi, metodologi serta validasinya. Implementasi COBIT tidak otomatis memenuhi ISO atau regulasi. Demo merupakan alur kecil yang representatif, bukan klaim sebagai platform operasional klien RSM.
slides.notesEn: RSM Indonesia offers business process reengineering for internal audit: clarify decisions, roles, evidence and review gates before digitising the workflow. The presenters also confirm development of AI-supported COBIT assessment systems. Explain criteria mapping, evidence organisation, suggested conclusions and accountable review. This can be expanded to ISO and recurring regulatory compliance assessments, provided each criteria set, licence, methodology and validation requirement is addressed. It does not mean one COBIT implementation automatically satisfies ISO or regulation. The demonstration is a small representative workflow, not a claim that it is an operational RSM client platform.

slides.title: SIGNAL Framework
slides.lead: A framework for continuous risk assurance.
slides.notes:
SIGNAL adalah framework pengajaran dari materi presenter, bukan standar eksternal. S Sense: tangkap sumber beserta asal dan tanggal; I Interpret: kaitkan objective dan registered risk; G Gauge: jelaskan asumsi yang mungkin berubah dan ketidakpastian; N Notify: sampaikan kepada owner yang tepat; A Act: manusia menerima/menolak, merevisi assessment dan memutuskan response; L Learn: periksa pelaksanaan dan efektivitas serta gunakan bukti berikutnya. AI dapat mendukung S I G N; manusia dapat menantang semua tahap dan mempunyai authority pada A L. Jangan membuat notifikasi menjadi auto-update skor tanpa persetujuan. Sistem demo menggunakan prepared examples dan rule transparan, bukan live model atau stream terjadwal.

slides.title: Signal review and risk-response workflow
slides.lead: Accept or decline relevance, review the proposed score, and agree a response when exposure exceeds tolerance.
slides.notes:
Buka alert per risiko dan semua signal yang dipetakan ke risiko itu. Baca summary, why dan source. Accept/decline tiap signal; alasan penolakan tidak dipaksakan peritem. Setelah seluruhnya diputus, analisis saran likelihood/impact berdasarkan evidence yang diterima. Unverified social lead sendiri tidak menyebabkan suggested increase. P, S dan selection manusia terlihat pada risk map. Custom assessment membutuhkan reasoning. Jika assessment baru di atas tolerance, pilih/ubah mitigation beserta owner, due date dan expected likelihood/impact reduction. Finish menyimpan semua keputusan, assessment dan plan sekaligus. Tidak menghitung tiga signal berkorelasi sebagai tiga kenaikan yang dijumlahkan.

slides.title: Technical references for AI use and data protection
slides.lead: Primary product documentation and data-disclosure guidance, reviewed 7 November 2026.
slides.notes:
Dokumentasi ini menjelaskan penggunaan sehari-hari pada layanan tertentu. OpenAI agent security menjelaskan permission dan network control; ChatGPT Work enterprise membedakan retensi per fitur. Claude Code membedakan local execution dan remote inference, consumer/commercial data use serta read permissions. OWASP mendukung lensa disclosure dan prompt injection. Jangan menggunakan ketentuan satu produk untuk produk lain atau menyebut ilustrasi sebagai kebijakan RSM. Ketentuan, fitur dan setting harus diverifikasi pada saat penggunaan.

Pertanyaan: The references behind everyday AI use. Penghubung: Primary product documentation and data-disclosure guidance, reviewed 7 November 2026.

narrative.question: The references behind everyday AI use.
narrative.transition: Primary product documentation and data-disclosure guidance, reviewed 7 November 2026.

slides.notesEn:
Provider terms depend on the account, feature and service. API training defaults must not be applied to all personal chatbot accounts. Retention, inference location, tools and permission to share remain separate controls.

OpenAI · Agent approvals & security: Product-specific guidance on agent permissions, sandboxing and command networking. Shell restrictions do not establish offline model inference or cover every hosted search, app or MCP path. Diagrams simplify these distinctions for general audiences; they do not reproduce the exact interface.

OpenAI · ChatGPT Work enterprise overview: Enterprise/Edu Work documentation: conversations, uploaded files, memory and connected sources can have distinct retention and deletion lifecycles. Not a universal consumer ChatGPT or API policy.

OpenAI · API data controls: API-specific documentation reviewed 13 November 2026: API data is not used for training by default unless opted in. Retention and processing controls are separate. Do not apply this statement to every personal chatbot account or feature.

Anthropic · Claude Code data usage: Claude Code documentation distinguishes consumer and commercial data use, model-improvement choices and feedback/session-sharing. Conditions depend on the account and feature; not a statement of every provider’s terms.

Anthropic · Claude Code permissions: Supported tool permissions, file-read restrictions and scopes. Read-only, working directory and gitignore are not interchangeable privacy boundaries; verify the actual tool configuration.

Anthropic · Claude Code user FAQ: Primary product explanation: CLI tools can read local source content and send it to hosted inference. This is specific to cloud-backed Claude Code use, not every local agent or offline model.

OWASP · Sensitive data disclosure · 2025: LLM02:2025. Data sanitisation, least privilege, source restriction and disclosure risk. A control in a prompt or a redaction step is not a complete privacy guarantee.

OWASP · Prompt injection · 2025: LLM01:2025. Untrusted content can redirect an LLM application; controls must address the application, tools and permissions rather than relying on a system prompt alone.
